Only a unit test of blockedOfHandoff and endedStatusText asserts the new words (validation rules 1 and 2). GET /sessions/:id and the Sessions list pass `stillBlocked(rt.store, s.handoff)` as blockedNow (server.ts:2362, :1928, :1949). `stillBlocked` (views.ts:693-712) does not read handoff.review_waits, so endedStatusText gets {needYou, paused} with no reviewWaits. The Sessions row's count words ('1 done, 1 paused'), stillWaitsText and the log's end line 'Session over: 1 done, 1 paused.' were not changed either. The user guide's new paragraph promises that a task whose review waits 'says so in every place', which is not true.
